title: Engineered Computers [OC & IE Compat Textures]
description: Makes OpenComputers stuff look more like Immersive Engineering stuff
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b67996165804f4289f303ae8eee4ea40cfff7611_0.webp)

**Whenever i played Modpacks with Immersive Engineering and OpenComputers, i was always kinda annoyed by the artstyles being super different. The fix for that is here**

* So far all OpenComputers Blocks have been adjusted to look more like IE Blocks
* Same goes for all OpenComputers GUIs.
* works well with other IE themed Resource Packs (made for 1.12.2)

![main image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9668325528ed8be68ed6d5a3d84240a41f79b52b.jpeg)

## Notes
* Items are not adjusted yet, i will probably do that soon aswell.

Additionally:
* There are some connected Textures files in here, so certain Blocks should look different, when clustered together, if a Mod is installed, that enables that.
* Some models have been changed, all in vanilla format.

## Incompatabilities
I don't think there are any, since it doesn't modify anything, it just extends existing stuff, but let me know if you find something.
